accepted.evidence: Australian online home and giftware retailer (Instagram lists Sydney, NSW) selling home decor, kitchen accessories, planters, vases and gifts with $12 flat-rate AU shipping. accepted.notes: Founder name not found in results, so greeting uses Team.

Hi Team,

I was looking through your bookend range, from the robot to the owl designs, and it made me wonder how much time goes into writing listings for so many individual gift pieces across your vendor collections.

I build AI assistants for Shopify stores that draft product titles, descriptions, SEO text and tags from supplier details, and keep collections tidy as new stock lands. Your team reviews and approves everything before it goes live.

Would it be useful if I showed you how that could work on a handful of your newest products?

Best regards,
Cynthia Nana
